meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Payment System Indicators (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: Monthly figures are provisional when first printed and may be revised in later Bulletins; the RBI re-organised the table in November 2019, and the two layouts are kept apart.
meta.coverage: Every payment system the RBI counts, month by month since November 2019: number and value of RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, UPI, NACH, AePS, card, prepaid and cheque payments, mobile and internet channels, and cash withdrawals at ATMs, PoS and micro ATMs
meta.note: RBI Bulletin Table 45, Payment System Indicators, via DBIE report 612 (ACTUALS display unit). Volumes are numbers of transactions; values are rupees. Card payments exclude cash withdrawals, which are their own lines. The RBI re-organised this table from November 2019; the old layout (April 2004 to October 2019) is a different ruler, baked apart and never joined.
